locked_title: Graph Convolutional Network based on Hyperbolic Space for Power Load Forecasting

forecast.training_target_rule: target position must be strictly before the block anchor
forecast.validation: last 15 percent of eligible training origins by time; checkpoint selection only
forecast.position_caveat: window and lead are processed positions, not guaranteed elapsed hours

ausgrid_hierarchy_17.timestamp_semantics: source-derived naive hourly labels; no timezone asserted
ausgrid_hierarchy_17.materialization_gate: all exact labels and full 672-origin blocks must exist in the hashed processed file or execution stops

opsd_six_country_functional_graph.timestamp_semantics: UTC source timestamp retained after complete-case filtering
opsd_six_country_functional_graph.materialization_gate: each anchor must resolve to the inherited processed-row index and a full 672-origin block or execution stops

normalization.rule: per node sample mean and sample standard deviation from finite load values strictly before each outer block anchor
normalization.reuse: freeze within block and reuse unchanged for internal validation and test
normalization.failure: zero or non-finite standard deviation fails the cell

covariates.semantics: sequence-phase features computed only from processed target position

real_graphs.opsd_six_country_functional_graph: absolute Pearson correlation >= 0.7 with >=168 pairwise-finite training-prefix rows, rebuilt per outer split

graph_provenance.identity: zero off-diagonal adjacency; self-loops enter only in convolution normalization
graph_provenance.random: uniform deterministic undirected edge sampling with graph_seed=20260905 and the real graph edge count; Ausgrid control must be a connected tree

ablation_contract.geometry_only: HGCN-Fixed1-Real minus EuclideanGCN-Real; same real graph and matched architecture/training
ablation_contract.inheritance: identity and random arms inherit the selected hyperparameters of their same-geometry real-graph arm and are not retuned

tuning.selection_metric: median development-block WAPE after averaging three seeds within each block
tuning.visibility: release every tuning row and the deterministic selection ledger
tuning.disjointness: no development block or tuning seed occurs in formal evaluation

training_budget.loss: mean squared error on normalized node targets
training_budget.checkpoint: lowest internal-validation MSE over all 20 completed epochs
training_budget.resource_gate: pilot records wall time and peak memory; author resource acceptance is required before formal execution

primary_outcomes.definition: mean of leaf-pooled, region-pooled, and root WAPE within a block
WAPE pooled over six nodes and all forecasts within a block

calibration.forbidden_claim: mean signed error is descriptive bias, not probabilistic calibration

comparison_family.scope: seven frozen WAPE contrasts in each of Ausgrid and OPSD, corrected together
comparison_family.test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip test over eight block differences
comparison_family.analysis_unit: rolling-origin block after averaging five paired seeds within trainable method-block cells; persistence has one deterministic block value
comparison_family.effect: mean paired WAPE difference; negative favors the first named method
comparison_family.confidence_interval: pointwise 95 percent percentile bootstrap over blocks with 20000 resamples

multiplicity.scope: all 14 primary WAPE contrasts as one family

failure_policy.pre_execution_infrastructure_failure: one documented rerun with identical cell and environment before data/model execution
failure_policy.algorithm_numerical_timeout_or_resource_: retain failed row; no replacement seed and no imputation
failure_policy.paired_inference: a missing member makes the primary contrast incomplete; no favorable complete-case test

negative_result_policy: report every null, adverse, failed, unstable, and resource-limited outcome; no dataset/seed subset, secondary metric, learned-curvature variant, or historical result may rescue a failed primary claim

pilot.scope: one Ausgrid development block for code, leakage, schema, numerical, memory, and runtime checks only; pilot seeds are disjoint from tuning and formal seeds
